title: 第15章 你我本无缘全靠我加钱第16章 小树林的会面
slug: 我都无敌了要你这系统有何用
content_zh:
九叔他们刚刚缓过来一些，就立马冲进房子里找任家父女，正好碰到被墨斗网缠住的僵尸，只见那僵尸本根不关心他们三个，一路猛跳仿佛火烧屁股一般，九叔看出它是在害怕，仿佛里面有什么恐怖的东西一般。
不一会就离开了他们的视线。
青墨和任家父女一起出去，正好碰到了九叔他们。
“任老爷你们没事吧？”
“没事，没事辛苦九叔了！”
“唉……，怪我学艺不精没拦住它，险些让你们遇害。
对了，你们身边这位是？”
“九叔好！”
青墨抱拳行礼，九叔急忙回礼。
青墨见九叔满脸疑惑，便解释了一番。
“原来如此！
虽然它被赶跑了，但是始终是个祸患啊！
若不尽早除掉，定会危害苍生。”
“九叔放心它的两个血亲还在这里，它还会再来的，到时候把一切都准备好一定能把它除掉”
“只能如此了。”
随后青墨表示想和九叔学习看风水，并且愿意出学费。
原本九叔想着婉拒，人家不费力就把僵尸赶跑了，自己打了半天还被打伤了。
“哎呀九叔，像您这样的道家高人，怎么会拒绝我这种晚辈的小小请求呢？况且我也对风水这块感兴趣，您应该不会拒绝吧？”
说着就从怀里摸出两颗鸡蛋大小的金子，塞到九叔手里。
“嗯！

既然现在的年轻人有喜欢学习风水的，我这个当前辈的自当传授！”
九叔义正词严的表示，只要愿意学，自己倾囊相授。
随后便带着徒弟们先回去疗伤，交代青墨明日来义庄。
青墨看了看秋生，眼睛瞄了下他的腰子。
今晚秋生可有得来忙咯！
在九叔离开后，任老爷迫不及待询问青墨。
神仙，你不是说九叔能帮我度过这劫吗？怎么还能让僵尸差点把我俩都害了？”
青墨看了眼任婷婷，任老爷连忙会意，让任婷婷回房休息。
“出现了一些变故，原本你就应该在昨晚被你老爹害死，我出手救了你改变了一些事情，间接的影响到未来。”
“啊？那怎么办啊？我会不会到头来还是被我老爹杀了吧？”
“这你放心，你家里有没有玉石，我帮你刻块玉佩，你随身带着，这僵尸还是需要九叔除掉才行。
以后也别叫我神仙了！
我叫青墨直接称呼我名字就行。”
“这，这样多少有些不敬吧？我怎么能直呼您的大名啊？”
content_en:
As soon as Uncle Jiu and the others recovered a little, they rushed into the house to look for the Ren family's father and daughter. They happened to encounter the zombie entangled in the ink net. The zombie didn't care about the three of them at all. It jumped all the way as if its buttocks were on fire. Uncle Jiu could tell that it was scared, as if there was something terrifying inside.
After a while, he left their sight.
Qing Mo went out with the Ren family's father and daughter, and happened to meet Uncle Jiu and the others.
"Master Ren, are you okay?"
"It's okay, it's okay, thank you for your hard work, Uncle Jiu!"
"Alas... I blame it on my lack of skills and not stopping it, and you almost got killed.
By the way, who is this person next to you? "
"Hello Uncle Jiu!"
Qing Mo cupped his fists and saluted, and Uncle Jiu hurriedly returned the salute.
Seeing Uncle Jiu's puzzled face, Qing Mo explained.
"That's it!
Although it was driven away, it was still a disaster!
If it is not eliminated as soon as possible, it will definitely endanger the common people. "
"Uncle Jiu, don't worry, its two blood relatives are still here. It will come again. When the time comes, we will prepare everything to get rid of it."
"That's all."
Later, Qing Mo expressed that he wanted to learn Feng Shui from Uncle Jiu and was willing to pay for the tuition.
Uncle Jiu originally wanted to politely refuse, but the zombies were driven away without any effort, and he himself was injured after fighting for a long time.
"Oh Uncle Jiu, how could a Taoist master like you refuse a small request from a junior like me? Besides, I'm also interested in Feng Shui, so you shouldn't refuse, right?"
As he spoke, he took out two pieces of gold the size of eggs from his arms and stuffed them into Uncle Jiu's hands.
"Hmm!
Since some young people today like to learn Feng Shui, I, the current generation, should teach it! "
Uncle Jiu said righteously that as long as he was willing to learn, he would teach him everything he had.
Then he took his disciples back to heal his wounds and told Qing Mo to come to Yizhuang tomorrow.
Qing Mo looked at Qiu Sheng and glanced at his waist.
Qiusheng is very busy tonight!
After Uncle Jiu left, Master Ren couldn't wait to ask Qing Mo.
God, didn’t you say that Uncle Jiu could help me survive this calamity? How could we let zombies almost kill us both? "
Qing Mo glanced at Ren Tingting, and Master Ren quickly understood and asked Ren Tingting to go back to her room to rest.
"Some changes occurred. You were supposed to be killed by your father last night. I rescued you and changed some things, which indirectly affected the future. "
"ah? What should we do? Will I be killed by my father in the end? "
"Don't worry, do you have jade at home? I'll carve a jade pendant for you and you can carry it with you. Uncle Jiu still needs to get rid of this zombie.
Don’t call me a god again!
My name is Qing Mo. Just call me by my name. "
"Well, this is somewhat disrespectful, isn't it? How can I call you by your first name? "
